title: ns-gm CLI Subcommands (helix-cli)
description: Tour of the two new CLI subcommands: hlx inspect netsuite and hlx run, with router wiring.

steps.title: cmdNetsuite Handler
steps.description: 60-line handler for 'hlx inspect netsuite'. Two modes: SuiteQL query (--query or positional arg) and log retrieval ('logs' subcommand with optional --script-id). Reads nsDefaultEnv from manifest for default --env value.

steps.title: cmdRun Handler
steps.description: 53-line handler for 'hlx run'. Flags: --repo (required), --code, --modules (comma-separated), --env (optional, defaults from manifest). POSTs to /{repoId}/run via hxFetch.

steps.title: Inspect Router - netsuite case
steps.description: case 'netsuite' dispatches to cmdNetsuite after extracting --repo flag. Follows the same pattern as existing db/logs/api cases in the inspect switch.

steps.title: Main Dispatcher - run case
steps.description: case 'run' dispatches to cmdRun with configOrHelp guard. Top-level command alongside existing inspect/sdf commands.
